title: Doubly Robust Deep Kernel Tests for Structured Outcomes
abstract: arXiv:2610.37227v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a test of whether two interventions induce the same outcome distribution when outcomes are structured and high-dimensional, such as images, text and graphs. We represent the interventional distributions as mean embeddings on learned deep features, such that the treatment effect is a doubly robust representation of the difference in mean embeddings. Our test, DR-KTE-Deep, optimises the learned features so as to maximise an estimated power criterion on this treatment effect representation. To motivate our learning objective, we show that the power criterion characterises the asymptotic signal-to-noise ratio of the test under fixed alternatives, and we derive a uniform finite-sample bound for its regularised estimate. We show that, with the learned kernel fixed, a held-out test is asymptotically valid under the null given suitable nuisance-estimation rates. translated_title: 面向结构化结果的双重稳健深度核检验
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种检验方法，用于判断两种干预是否诱导出相同的结果分布，适用于结果为结构化且高维的情形，例如图像、文本和图数据。我们将干预分布表示为在所学习的深度特征上的均值嵌入，使得处理效应成为均值嵌入差异的一种双重稳健表示。我们的检验方法 DR-KTE-Deep 通过最大化该处理效应表示上的估计功效准则来优化所学习的特征。为该学习目标提供理论依据，我们证明了该功效准则刻画了检验在固定备择假设下的渐近信噪比，并为其正则化估计推导出一致的有限样本界。我们进一步证明，在所学核固定的情况下，只要干扰参数的估计速率合适，基于保留样本的检验在原假设下是渐近有效的。从实证结果来看，DR-KTE-Deep 相比固定……方法取得了显著更高的检验功效（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出 DR-KTE-Deep 检验，通过在双重稳健的均值嵌入差异表示上最大化估计功效准则来学习深度特征，从而对图像、文本、图等结构化高维结果下两种干预是否诱导相同分布实现高功效且渐近有效的统计检验。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DR-KTE-Deep, a doubly robust deep kernel test that learns deep features by maximizing an estimated power criterion on the treatment-effect representation, enabling high-power and asymptotically valid testing of whether two interventions induce the same distribution over structured, high-dimensional outcomes such as images, text, and graphs.
